shortDescription: Manage BIG-IP APM policy or APM access profile imports

options.name: force
options.description: When set to C(true) any existing policy with the same name will be overwritten by the new import. If a policy does not exist, this setting is ignored.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the APM policy or APM access profile to create or override.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: reuse_objects
options.description: When set to C(true) and objects referred within the policy exist on the BIG-IP, those will be used instead of the objects defined in the policy. Reusing existing objects reduces configuration size. The configuration of existing objects might differ to the configuration of the objects defined in the policy!

options.name: source
options.description: Full path to a file to be imported into the BIG-IP APM.

options.name: type
options.description: Specifies the type of item to export from the device.
